mapper.select: SELECT f.id as food_id, f.name as food_name, s.id as store_id, s.name as store_name, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as total_sales FROM order_detail oi JOIN food f ON oi.food_id = f.id JOIN store s ON f.store_id = s.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status like 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY oi.food_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id as food_id, f.name as food_name, f.image as food_image, SUM(oi.quantity) as sale_count, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as sale_amount FROM order_detail oi JOIN food f ON oi.food_id = f.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY oi.food_id ORDER BY sale_count DESC
